statements.statement: Patient presenting with episodes of dizziness (R42)
Patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
Continuous rhythm monitoring is required to capture rhythm data and correlate symptomatic events with potential cardiac dysrhythmias
Intermittent symptoms make rhythm documentation otherwise difficult
The claim was denied with reason code CO-50
The denial reason is that the service does not meet criteria for medical necessity
